title: Scan-Lit Documentary — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Two passes, one relationship
scenes.purpose: A radar sweep finds an idea on pass 1 and a connected system on pass 2. The relationship is drawn only once both findings are visible.
visuals: Dark radar disc with navy graticule and bearing ticks
Teal instrument sweep with a timed cumulative scanning mask over registered evidence layers
Cream evidence marks: E1 single point, E2 three-node triangle
Small evidence labels on dark backing tagged P1/P2
Left case-file column with serif headline and PASS indicators

beats.development: Graticule rings draw in. The headline and case-file column fade up. Unscanned disc stays near black.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system.

beats.development: Pass 1 (SIGNAL highlighted): the sweep reveals the scanned lower region. E1 pings at about 0.78s and its label E1 · IDEA (P1) appears.
Pass 2 (NETWORK highlighted): the sweep crosses the upper-right region. Three nodes appear at about 1.54–1.59s, the triangle draws and the label E2 · SYSTEM (P2) appears.
With both findings visible, a dashed relationship line draws from E1 to E2. The LINKED · PASS 2 label and subtitle appear, the sweep slows and dims, and everything holds settled from 2.5s.
captions: Two signals, two passes, one relationship.

findings: The sweep runs at a constant rate through one full revolution (0.25–1.85s). Each finding appears at the exact moment the arm crosses its bearing.
The comparison waits until 1.95s, after both findings are visible.
justifiedHolds: 2.5–3.0s settled reading hold on the relationship and subtitle.

notes: Illustrative reconstruction: the radar returns, clutter dots and evidence positions are procedural, seeded vector graphics. They are not measured data.
